gaps.sentence: ___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.

gaps.explanation: 'Optimistic' is the adjective; 'optimism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The minister was ___ (CRITIC) for her handling of the flooding crisis.
gaps.explanation: 'Be criticised for' = be attacked verbally; the verb form is needed in the passive.

gaps.sentence: Her ___ (APPOINT) as captain surprised no one.
gaps.explanation: 'Her appointment as captain' — the event of being appointed.
